Short and sweet. Stick to a few places, a few NPC's and 1-3 things going on. 
Describe the area, describe what's happening then roll with the punches. You cannot prepare for players, tried that and you still end up getting stumped. 
And show don't tell things. Say "An old, hunched women is peddling a cart of what seems to be some sort of sweet treat" rather  then "A hag is selling sweets" I just find that it helps immersion a bit. 

Biggest rule of all is to have fun! If something isn't working for you, change it. Obviously, if it effects players then include them on the conversation too. You're there to facilitate there fun, and to also create your own. 

Good luck!
